# statuspal-next_outgoing_webhook (Resource)

Manages an organization-level outgoing webhook subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspal-next_outgoing_webhook" "ops_alerts" {
  name = "Ops alerts"
  url  = "https://hooks.example.com/statuspal"

  events = [
    "notice.created",
    "notice.updated",
    "service.status_changed",
  ]

  enabled = true

  # Scope to specific status pages. Omit (or set all_status_pages = true) to fire
  # for every status page in the organization.
  all_status_pages       = false
  status_page_subdomains = ["acme-status"]
}

# The signing secret is returned only on create and stored in state.
output "webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = statuspal-next_outgoing_webhook.ops_alerts.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Events that trigger a delivery. One or more of: `service.status_changed`, `notice.created`, `notice.update_posted`, `notice.updated`.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the webhook.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL that receives `POST` deliveries.

### Optional

- `all_status_pages` (Boolean) When `true`, fires for events on every status page in the organization (including pages created later). When `false`, only the pages in `status_page_subdomains` fire.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active.
- `status_page_subdomains` (Set of String) Subdomains of the status pages this webhook is scoped to. Required when `all_status_pages` is `false`; ignored otherwise.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) TypeID-prefixed identifier (e.g. `wbk_…`).
- `last_attempted_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent delivery attempt.
- `last_triggered_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent successful delivery.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext signing secret (`whs_…`), returned only when the webhook is created. Stored in state so signature verification can use it; it cannot be retrieved from the API afterwards.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp at which the webhook was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Outgoing webhooks are imported by their TypeID. The signing secret cannot be
# recovered on import (it is only returned at creation/rotation time).
terraform import statuspal-next_outgoing_webhook.ops_alerts wbk_01h2x4q9k7m4n3v5w6r8t1y0z2
```
